en: A colorized historic postcard showing a large castle-like complex with a prominent round tower at the corner and a long, light-colored rectangular building extending to the right, with many evenly spaced windows and a slender spire rising from a central tower. In the foreground is an empty cobblestone square with a row of trees on the right side. On the left stands an older, darker-roofed house. In the sky area at the upper right, printed text labels the scene.
